surface: Modern Mapbox GL JS 3.5+ and MapLibre GL JS 4+ entry points with Map, Marker, Popup, controls, Source, Layer, MapProvider, useMap, useControl, engine-specific refs/events/types, and verified pristine/adapted runtime and type lanes.
divergences: Refs are passed as ordinary props instead of React forwardRef wrappers.
React StrictMode's development-only double mount is not reproduced.
The upstream mapbox-legacy entry is not included; Mapbox GL JS 1.13 requires a separate controller and type boundary.
ssr: The component renders its container during SSR and imports/constructs the selected WebGL map library only in a client effect. Child map components mount after the map instance is available.
notes: Real production browser lanes compile authored source with Vite and verify Mapbox and MapLibre WebGL, controls, overlays, style data, events, resize, teardown, and MapLibre map/canvas reuse.
The Mapbox lane always executes with an offline style and switches to the hosted streets style when MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN is available.
The pinned legacy visual fixtures remain out of scope because the initial binding intentionally omits mapbox-legacy.
